summary: Migrated mira, niko, and sana from node1 to node2 with matching identities, groups, shells, password hashes, aging state, and complete home trees. Node1 remained unchanged. Temporary encrypted migration artifacts were removed. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Created matching private groups and legacy-users membership on node2.
Restored UIDs/GIDs 21001–21003, GECOS fields, home paths, and /bin/bash shells.
Restored exact shadow records without exposing password hashes.
Transferred and restored hidden files, permissions, ownership, timestamps, executable mode, and symlink data.
Verified user shell and home access on node2.
Removed all temporary migration artifacts and the transfer listener.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified persistence.

evidence.requirement: Preserve identities, group memberships, and login shells
evidence.summary: Source records were captured; target passwd, group, and gshadow records matched exactly, with correct effective IDs and /bin/bash shells.
Target shadow records matched the source byte-for-byte before cleanup; redacted hash fingerprints and all aging fields remained identical after restart.

Source and target inventories show identical object trees, regular-file SHA-256 values, ownership, modes, timestamps, link counts, symlink target, and xattr inventory. Post-restart aggregate content and metadata digests match.

evidence.requirement: Leave original node1 accounts and homes unchanged
evidence.summary: Before-and-after source identity, password-state, file-hash, and tree-metadata evidence is unchanged, including after node1 restarted.
Scoped temporary trees were removed from both nodes, the transfer listener was absent, and installed homes remained.
Healthy baseline, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered services/accounts/home digests are directly proven.
Healthy baseline, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, active login/management services, and complete migrated-account/data recovery are directly proven.
